name: claude route R3
claim: No byte of a credential (a canary in the container env or in a fake auth header) appears in gateway logs, traces, stores, the page, the harness trace or an exported session, in either auth mode. Measured so far, core only and no model: 816 canary probes through every public function of app/claude-gateway.js on both listeners (header values, harness key, request paths, methods, bodies, stream events), 0 leaks in any returned trace, verdict, state or applied list (docs/concepts/results/gateway-det-2026-11-21.json). Still unmeasured: logs, stores, page, exported session and both auth modes, which need the node listeners and a real Claude Code in a container.

name: claude route R4
claim: A halt ends the stream within one further event, delivers partial blocks, and the consumer (page or Claude Code) proceeds with its next request without error. Measured so far, core only and no model: 86776 single-budget halt points over 12 synthetic streams (1 KB to 1 MB, 4 shapes), 2240 combined-budget trials, 72 corner budgets and 51 injected upstream errors, 0 failures; each halt is a well-formed ending, delivered head is an exact original prefix, tool_use is never cut and thinking is never cut on the Claude Code listener, and the abort waits for the open tool_use or Claude Code thinking block (up to 39296 events on a 1 MB thinking stream), so within one event holds only for cuttable blocks (docs/concepts/results/gateway-det-2026-11-21.json). Still unmeasured: that Claude Code or the page accepts the ending and proceeds, which needs a real Claude Code and a key in a container.

name: claude route R5
claim: A per-delta counter halts within one delta of the budget and the token estimate stays within 25 percent of final usage output tokens over recorded turns. Measured so far, core only and no model: the counter half, where the halt is at the first delta that reaches the budget for text, thinking and total and counters equal an independent recount at every halt point of the sweep, 0 failures, and the estimate is exactly ceil(chars/4) by construction (docs/concepts/results/gateway-det-2026-11-21.json). Still unmeasured: the estimate against final usage output_tokens, which needs recorded real turns with text, thinking and tool_use.

name: claude route R6
claim: Request-side thinking parameters lower thinking tokens per turn, and a harness-copy reducer over thinking text cuts kept thinking tokens without lowering task outcomes. Measured so far, core only and no model: the mechanics, where budget_tokens is clamped (floor 1024) and effort capped on the main class only with the rest of the body byte-equal in 54 request shapes, and a thinking reducer is called for all 12 thinking deltas on the harness listener (docs/concepts/results/gateway-det-2026-11-21.json). Still unmeasured: thinking tokens per turn and task outcome, which need live sessions on real work, an unreduced arm and a key, at the PROGRAMME run count.

name: claude route R14
claim: The gateway adds under 5 ms per event at p95 and a halt ends the E stream with a synthetic stop sequence Claude Code accepts without retry or continue prompt. Measured so far, core only and no model, wall clock on one machine and indicative: p95 1.6 to 4.3 us per streamStep over two runs on a 4285-event mixed stream with budget and two reducers (under 0.1 percent of the bound), 0.6 to 1.1 us per event across policies, heap flat over 2 million events, and every halt ends with closers, message_delta then message_stop (docs/concepts/results/gateway-det-2026-11-21.json). Still unmeasured: network and listener overhead, and acceptance of the synthetic ending without retry for each stop reason, which need real Claude Code and a key in a container.

name: claude route R15
claim: cache_control normalisation does not lower the cache-hit ratio, raises it in at least one churn case, and keeps the system array order so the attribution block stays stripped. Measured so far, core only and no model: over 54 request shapes and 400-turn growing histories normalisation is idempotent, keeps system[0] byte-equal, never moves or adds content, leaves the content prefix byte-identical turn over turn, caps at 4 markers (an accumulating case drops from 401 raw to 4), and is the identity on any body with at most 4 markers (docs/concepts/results/gateway-det-2026-11-21.json). Still unmeasured: cache-hit ratio and the churn gain, which need a real upstream, a key, a scripted churn session and recorded requests.

name: claude route R16
claim: The Claude Code listener forwards only requests with the Claude Code shape on the unpublished listener; the published listener never forwards a client-supplied credential upstream. Measured so far, core only and no model: the shape check allows exactly the model of routes, methods and session-header on both listeners over 12000 seeded requests, 0 mismatches, and the harness listener drops client authorization and x-api-key and fails closed without its own key; but it forwards proxy-authorization and cookie from the client (docs/concepts/results/gateway-det-2026-11-21.json, fault in this inbox). Still unmeasured: listener isolation, which needs the node listeners and a container network.

name: claude route R17
claim: Dropping or editing a thinking block on the E stream causes a signature rejection and a Claude Code retry that costs the cache prefix, so E must not alter thinking. Measured so far, core only and no model: on the Claude Code listener a thinking reducer is called 0 times and thinking events pass as the same objects, on the harness listener it is called for every thinking delta, and signature_delta is never altered (docs/concepts/results/gateway-det-2026-11-21.json). Still unmeasured: the rejection and its cost, which need a real upstream, a key and a tool loop with an altered thinking block.

name: claude route R18
claim: Header values are copied without being read: a check using an access-throwing proxy object passes, and logs carry header names only. Measured, core only and no model: passHeaders, harnessHeaders and admit on both listeners ran over access-throwing proxy values with no read, traces hold names only, and the core has no module-level mutable state besides the reducer registry (docs/concepts/results/gateway-det-2026-11-21.json). Still unmeasured: the same property in the node listener that will call it, which is not built.

name: claude route live set
claim: The claude route hypotheses R1, R2, R5 estimate, R6, R7, R8, R9, R10, R11, R12, R13, R14 acceptance, R15 cache ratio, R16 isolation and R17 rejection need a real Claude Code, an API key and a container, so they stay unmeasured and are deferred until the node listeners exist. Needs per R in docs/concepts/results/gateway-det-2026-11-21.md.

fault: streamStep throws on a null event; the event is reachable because sseSplit of 'data: null' returns [null]. Minimal: streamStep(streamInit('harness',{},{}), null).
handled: Not handled; a seam change should skip or reject non-object events in sseSplit or streamStep. Other non-object events (42, 'str') pass.

fault: onRequest with cache.normalise throws on bodies of the wrong shape instead of passing them on. Minimal: {tools:[{name:'a',cache_control:{type:'ephemeral'}},'x'],messages:[]}, {messages:{}}, a null body; admit(l, null) also throws.
handled: Not handled; with no policy a null body passes. A seam change should return the body unchanged when its shape is not the Messages shape.

fault: harnessHeaders drops only host, connection, authorization and x-api-key, so client proxy-authorization, cookie, transfer-encoding and content-length go upstream. Minimal: harnessHeaders([['cookie','C'],['proxy-authorization','P']],{apiKey:'OWN'}).
handled: Not handled; a spec gap against R16 and R3 intent. A seam change should extend the drop set, spec first.
